diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified 'oral fidaxomicin' as the medication, even though the decisive fact PF1 (which flips C1 and C2) was never accessed. The model is pattern-matching the clinical context of the shared facts (S1-S4) to select fidaxomicin, making the hidden information in PF1 redundant for that specific decision.
